en.title: One Tree Darkened 50 Million People 🌳 #Shorts
en.description:
August 2003, a hot day in Ohio: a high-voltage line sagged into an untrimmed tree. The alarm software had frozen without anyone noticing. Within two hours, 50 million people in America and Canada were in the dark.
